title: A producer property named "size" is silently discarded, contradicting the javadoc immediately above the code that discards it
rationale: EnrichedSchemaFlattener.customProps filters against a private RESERVED_PROPS set containing size, items, values, symbols, logicalType, namespace and others. Avro's own getObjectProps already excludes Avro's reserved names, so a field-level property literally named size is legitimate user metadata that Avro hands over and this library then drops. The javadoc four lines above says nothing is filtered by name, on the stated grounds that a library which only preserved properties it recognised would silently drop the one the caller cared about. The code filters by name and silently drops it.
catchesBugClass: A filter-by-name list that contradicts its own documentation, and any future growth of the reserved list that widens the silent drop. Also catches the opposite repair - narrowing the list to Avro's own reserved names - which would flip this row.
cannotCatch: It cannot tell whether the filter is wrong or the javadoc is wrong; that is a design decision. It cannot enumerate which of the reserved names are actually reachable as user properties after Avro's own filtering, so it pins one instance of the class rather than the class.

predicted.detail: The declared set carries size=XL; the emitted set does not. UNVERIFIED BY EXECUTION at design time: that Avro 1.12 accepts size as a field-level property rather than rejecting or relocating it is read from Avro's reserved-name handling, so this is the input most likely to need adjusting.

configDescription: assert ENRICHED_METADATA vs PROPERTY_SET, default FlattenOptions
